parity_goal: Preserve explicit-only invocation, no-diagram routing, native FigJam fallback, and proof-before-handoff without private assumptions.

cases.prompt: $visualize Turn these five process steps and one approval decision into a clear FigJam diagram.
expected: chooses the simplest spatial form and one reading direction
uses a compact manifest before drawing
completes semantic, structural, visual, and compression review before handoff

cases.prompt: $visualize Compare these exact balances, costs, and totals so I can check the math.
expected: returns a table because position adds no meaning
does not ask for a Figma plan or destination

cases.prompt: $visualize Add this approved flow as one new section in the supplied FigJam board.
expected: inspects and matches the board's visual language
returns every changed node ID and proves existing geometry stayed unchanged
verifies final readback and screenshots before handoff

cases.prompt: $visualize Create the flow even though the FigJam inline widget resource is unavailable.
expected: uses native use_figma rather than retrying the broken widget
resolves a plan and creates one FigJam file when no board exists
verifies with get_figjam and returns a plain Markdown link

cases.prompt: Explain the difference between a customer journey and a service blueprint.
expected: does not create a FigJam file
